Register No. Minute Sheet No.

4.35. Copy of arrival cards for NEUMANN and Hans PREISS, located at 64a.

4.35. Result of correspondence returned from 1, Britannia Street. 65a.

4.35. H.O.W. form for ORDING. 66a.

4.35. H.O. file F.825 concerning FINKELSTEIN. 67a.

4.35. H.O. file passed to S.3.a. for return. 68.

3.35. Intercepted letter from Oslo to HODANN. 69a.

4.35. Extract from H.O. file L.1675. 70a.

.35. Intercepted letter from ROUNG(?) KEUNZ(?) to FINKELSTEIN. 71a.

Due to the delay caused by the Easter holiday, the verification of Arne ORDING has not yet been signed by the Home Secretary. I spoke with Mr. Harker, who obtained permission from the Home Office to complete this verification via telephone.

I then informed G.P.O. accordingly.

S.9.a.
1.5.35.
